title: Fourth Meeting

lines.speaker: genie
lines.text: This is it. He's waiting for you.

lines.speaker: genie
lines.text: Listen carefully… he will offer you a deal.

lines.speaker: genie
lines.text: He'll promise to return Jasmine… if you give up your final wish.

lines.speaker: genie
lines.text: Then you'll have to fight him at full strength… and risk losing everything.

lines.speaker: aladdin
lines.text: I'm not trading her life for a trick, I will fight him!!
